name: av_ev_two_wide_apart
source:
{ The same two guards, now far enough apart that they cannot share a step:
  both must fire, in time order. Read against av_ev_two_in_one_step this
  brackets the one-hit-per-step rule. }
DYNAMIC ramp (method = ode45, time = 0 .. 10, points = 6)
  der(Yv) = 1
  Yv(0) = 0
  EVENT a: Yv = 3 | rising -> record
  EVENT b: Yv = 7 | rising -> record
END
